punchline: Ambedkar wrote to Du Bois and asked for a copy of a petition.
thirty_sec: In a letter thought to date from 1946, B. R. Ambedkar asked W. E. B. Du Bois for copies of the National Negro Congress petition to the UN. Du Bois replied on 31 July 1946 with every sympathy for the Untouchables of India.
question: Whose finished work could you ask to see before your next hard piece of writing?
key_contrast: He asked for a draft instead of inventing one.
